events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire; Paul is arrested in Jerusalem (about AD 57).
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
An earthquake strikes the Lycus Valley (about AD 60 to 61); Nero is emperor.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from prison, about AD 60 to 62 (debated)

teaser.title: The gospel reaches Colossae
teaser.text: Epaphras brings the gospel to the Lycus Valley while Paul is teaching in Ephesus (Acts 19:10), about AD 52 to 55.

teaser.title: Colossians is written
teaser.text: Paul is a prisoner, probably in Rome, about AD 60 to 62.

teaser.title: The letter is delivered
teaser.text: Tychicus and Onesimus carry it, along with Philemon (4:7-9).

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
